in_marathi.name: Sharwanisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharwanisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharwanisha is derived from the Sanskrit words Sharva, which means 'God of Prosperity', and Ishani, which means 'Goddess of Strength'. This beautiful name signifies the embodiment of Goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity, who is often depicted holding a lotus flower in her hands.
